subproblem.title: Every current of degree d > P on a subset of ℝ^P is zero
subproblem.statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ with P < d, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set and let A ∈ 𝒟_d(U). Then A = 0. Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. For D ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^d(D) = TestFormOn D d (smooth d-forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in D) and 𝒟_d(D) = GeometricCurrentOn D d; ∂X = X.boundary (∂X(ω) = X(dω)). For G ⊆ ℝ^P, M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of ofReal(X(ω)) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(D) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x; M(X) = X.mass = M_D(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in D is the contract structure IMRep D d; R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ(x) ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHᵈ(x); R represents X when X(ω) = R.action(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(D); μ_R = R.measure = (Hᵈ⌞M).withDensity θ; X is integer multiplicity (IM, IsIntegerMultiplicity X) if some IMRep in D represents it. For V ⊆ D, ι = testFormOnInclusion regards ω ∈ 𝒟^d(V) as an element of 𝒟^d(D) with the same underlying form, and X⌞V = X.restrictDomain (V ⊆ D) ∈ 𝒟_d(V) is given by X⌞V(ω) = X(ιω). X vanishes off a set K if X(ω) = 0 for every test form ω whose tsupport is disjoint from K.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A : GeometricCurrentOn U d), P < d → A = 0
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 0 of the parent proof (the case n > P).
1. Every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) is the zero form. Fix x ∈ ℝ^P. The value ω(x) is a continuous alternating d-linear map (ℝ^P)^d → ℝ (Covector is ContinuousAlternatingMap). Let v = (v_0, …, v_{d−1}) be any d vectors in ℝ^P. If v were linearly independent, then d = card(Fin d) ≤ dim ℝ^P = P (LinearIndependent.fintype_card_le_finrank, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin), contradicting P < d. So v is linearly dependent. An alternating multilinear map vanishes on linearly dependent families (AlternatingMap.map_linearDependent, applied to ω(x).toAlternatingMap), so ω(x)(v) = 0. Hence ω(x) = 0 for every x, the underlying form of ω is 0, and ω = 0 in 𝒟^d(U) (Subtype.ext).
2. A is linear, so A(ω) = A(0) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U).
3. Therefore A = 0 (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). ∎
proof_key_steps: Any d vectors in ℝ^P with d > P are linearly dependent, so every alternating d-covector on ℝ^P vanishes; hence every test d-form is 0.
A linear functional vanishes at 0, so A(ω) = A(0) = 0 for all ω, and A = 0 by extensionality.

audit.reason: For d>P every d-vector family is linearly dependent, so every alternating d-covector and test d-form vanishes. Linearity and current extensionality prove A=0. The proof covers arbitrary U and A with precisely the stated dimension hypothesis.
